name: The Initiates
source: The Initiates Plc Q2 2026 management accounts, statement of profit or loss for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), year to date June 2026 column. Values are printed in naira, not thousands. EPS as printed; the filing labels the row kobo but the values are naira, confirmed by the FY2025 column against 889,981,552 shares and by the printed Q2 2026 figure of 0.40 against profit of 803,935,677. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | blank split cells computed from the file's own stored totals (Gross Profit = Revenue - Cost of Sales; the current/non-current split sums to the total) | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 (nine months ended 30 September 2026) added from The Initiates Plc Q3 2026 interim filed with NGX (doclib filing library), statement of comprehensive income, YTD ended 30 September column, printed in naira millions and stored x1,000,000. Printed at that column: revenue 10,716.56; direct cost 5,335.86 (stored as Cost of Sales); gross profit 5,380.70; other income 403.89; total indirect cost 970.75 (stored as Operating Expenses); financial cost 2.06; profit before tax 4,811.77; provision of income tax expense 1,636.00; profit for the period 3,175.77. Ties: revenue less direct cost equals gross profit; gross profit plus other income less total indirect cost less financial cost equals profit before tax (5,380.70 + 403.89 - 970.75 - 2.06 = 4,811.78 against the printed 4,811.77, one unit of rounding); profit before tax less tax equals profit for the period. Operating Profit (EBIT) and EPS are not printed as separate lines on this page and are left empty for this period rather than derived.

reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2024: the filed operating profit is a subtotal that also carries operating income not shown as a separate row in this file, and it ties forward to Profit Before Tax. The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged. Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2025: this statement does not present operating profit as gross profit less one operating-expense line (the bridge runs through further income and expense headings the panel does not carry), so the two-row identity does not apply; every figure is as filed. Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit does not hold in FY2025, FY2024: this statement does not present gross profit as revenue less one cost-of-sales line, so the two-row identity does not apply; the figures are as filed.
